title: Messages stuck at the bottom of the chat — the card's colours

steps.path: Option A: the card exactly as on the round-4 deck (both notes shown, top amber, bottom red)
steps.headline: Option A, unchanged: the settings-page error card with its faint tint, which looks dark in a light bubble and pale in a dark one.
steps.changed: Nothing new. Why it looks off: the card takes the theme's own background, so in Midnight it is near-black inside a light-grey bubble, and in Light it is near-white inside a black bubble. Its tint is only 10% colour.
steps.notice: Pick this only if it looked fine after all.

steps.path: Option B: the chat's own error look (both notes shown, top amber, bottom red)
steps.headline: Option B: grey card with a solid amber or red outline, like the red-outlined error bubble the chat shows when a reply fails.
steps.changed: Grey card background (the same grey as Claude's reply bubbles) and a full-strength coloured outline instead of a faint tint.
steps.notice: Matches the chat's existing "something went wrong" bubble. The colour is only in the outline, so it is calmer.
steps.risk: Less colour overall; the amber outline is thin, so "not sure" reads quieter than it does now.

steps.path: Option C: the same card with twice the colour (both notes shown, top amber, bottom red)
steps.headline: Option C: the standard card with its tint about twice as strong, so it reads clearly amber or red in every theme.
steps.changed: Same card, same buttons, but the amber or red fill is about 22% instead of 10%, with a stronger border.
steps.notice: Clearly a warning or an error at a glance, in both dark and light themes.
steps.risk: Stronger than the same card on settings pages, so it is slightly louder than errors elsewhere.
